task.title: Project one stimulus-driven cross-loop run into current Management truth

acceptance.fresh_owner_identities: The closure gate starts the three domain E2E suites itself and accepts only their same-run, exact-SHA temporary reports; it accepts no prebuilt input manifest.
acceptance.twelve_loop_receipts: Every canonical loop requires non-empty trigger, terminal output, owner observation, authority readback, and next receipt before the parent report can pass.
acceptance.management_truth: The Runtime suite's same-run strict-auth BFF loop-health readback must contain exactly twelve canonical rows with current-record-derived runtime_maturity and no static maturity/task/evidence projection fields.
acceptance.functional_failure_attribution: During the isolated Runtime worker failure, BFF loop-health must attribute paper-fleet-reconciler degradation to capital_pool_execution (Loop 9).
acceptance.legacy_verifier_separation: The retained prebuilt-ID suite has a separate opt-in flag and report role; it is not a closure gate.

required_before_review: Run PANTHEON_L12_STIMULUS_CROSS_LOOP_E2E=1 against the exact controlled dev-paper deployment with all three domain suite configurations.
Commit the resulting bounded deployed run report, report SHA-256, exact deployed SHA, and final pass status before requesting independent review.
Reviewer independently reruns the focused local contracts and inspects that the committed run report contains twelve fresh loop receipts and BFF failure attribution.

review_decision.reviewer_action_required: Do not approve until a committed exact-SHA deployed stimulus report records status=passed and this manifest is updated on the reviewed head.
